shared_elements: closed oval/arched outline enclosing an inner motif
row of repeated angular or curved marks (chevrons in A, arcs in B)
justification: The only real correspondences are generic: both surfaces show a closed rounded outline enclosing smaller internal forms, and both include a register of repeated angular/curved marks (chevrons in A, a row of arcs beneath the hull in B). Otherwise the content is quite different — A shows a dense field of standardised script-like signs (bird in profile, disc, water lines) in vertical columns, while B shows a single large vessel-like structure with mast, angled yard-like elements and an arching frame, rendered in bare outline with no repeated sign vocabulary.
